title: Add provenance-diff playbook and weighted telemetry release notes generator
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce a reproducible 'provenance-diff' playbook that captures model, dataset, and ingest-sample deltas; add a weighted-telemetry summarizer that drafts concise release notes and impact bullets for curators and SRE. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: onboarding often produces noisy changelogs; reviewers need a reproducible checklist to evaluate behavioral deltas. This PR adds two complementary pieces: (1) a provenance-diff playbook that composes deterministic artifacts (manifest fingerprints, sample probes, telemetry rollup) so reviewers can reproduce observed changes locally or in CI; (2) a weighted telemetry release-notes generator that synthesizes short, prioritized bullets from telemetry signals (quality regressions, latency deltas, token-cost impact) using configurable weights so PMs can tune what appears in the autogenerated draft.

What this changes: single continuous change set implemented in the model-registry service and the onboarding tooling: - new command `mrctl diff-playbook <model-version> --seed-sample` which outputs a compact tarball with manifest.json, probe-samples.ndjson, deterministic inference harness script, and a concise provenance graph; - a telemetry summarizer that consumes the sampling bucket and outputs a human-readable release snippet and an optional Linear draft; - safety sanitizer hook that removes high-confidence PII from probe samples and marks samples as scrubbed in the provenance manifest.

Checklist: - [x] provenance manifest schema v1 (manifest.json) added and validated in onboarding CI - [x] deterministic sample extractor (seeded RNG) - [x] release-note summarizer with tunable weights and markdown output - [x] sample sanitizer + opt-in scrubbed flag - [x] unit + integration tests for playbook generation - [x] telemetry aggregation hook and draft Linear creation (opt-in)

Compatibility and scope: This is backward-compatible for existing onboard flows; the `mrctl` command is opt-in and the summarizer only writes drafts unless `--publish-draft` is provided. The change adds metadata fields to the model registry DB (provenance_hash, scrubbed_samples) but the fields are optional for older entries. No runtime serving changes are included.

How reviewers can validate locally: 1) `./dev/mrctl build-playbook --model-id model:open-sample:1.2 --seed 42` 2) run `./dev/playbook-runner reproduce.tar.gz` inside a small pinned Python venv (requirements included) 3) assert that the outputs (log/histograms/nbest diffs) match the CI artifact.

Related work: ENG-7245 (onboard-sanity-probes), PM-331 (release-note prioritization), SUP-1982 (customer request for concise impact bullets).

notes_for_ops: Ops: this adds optional DB columns (provenance_hash, scrubbed_samples boolean). Migration is online and idempotent; run migrations in the normal deploy window. Telemetry summarizer writes drafts to a drafts bucket in staging by default; enable production by flipping mrctl.config.publish_drafts and granting the Linear webhook secret. Backfill: not required. If rollback needed, remove playbook artifacts and drop metadata columns carefully after pruning references.
